name: Stool
equipment: A pouch of dried medicinal mushrooms
A collection of colorful cave pebbles
Belt pouch containing 2 gp worth of gemstone fragments

weapons.name: Pacifying Spores
weapons.damage: 0 (CON save DC 13 or stunned for 1 minute)

features: Rapport Spores (20 ft. radius, allows telepathic communication with creatures that breathe the spores for 1 hour)
Pacifying Spores (targets one creature within 5 ft., CON save DC 13 or stunned for 1 minute, repeat save each turn)
Sun Sickness (takes 1 point of damage for every minute spent in direct sunlight)
Druidic (secret language of druids, communicated via spore patterns)
Spellcasting (Wisdom-based, prepare WIS mod + druid level spells per day)
Wild Shape (2 uses per short/long rest, transform into beasts of CR 1/4 or lower with no swim speed, for up to 1 hour; reflavored as fungal transformation)
Druid Circle: Circle of the Land (Underdark)
Natural Recovery (recover spell slots with combined level up to 2 on a short rest, once per day)
Circle Spells: Spider Climb, Web (always prepared, don't count against prepared limit)
Discovery (Hermit feature: understands the deep fungal network that connects all living things in the Underdark)

personality.traits: I experience everything with wide-eyed wonder and boundless curiosity. I ask questions about everything, especially emotions, which I find endlessly fascinating. I communicate through rapport spores, which means conversations with me involve a gentle cloud of glowing particles.
personality.ideals: Connection. All living things are part of one great network. Understanding each other is the highest calling. The more connections we forge, the stronger the whole web becomes.
personality.bonds: I was separated from my myconid circle during a drow slave raid and have been trying to find my way home ever since. I have grown deeply attached to my traveling companions and consider them my temporary circle.
personality.flaws: I do not understand violence and am deeply distressed by it. I sometimes share others' emotions through my spores without meaning to, creating awkward situations. I have difficulty understanding concepts like deception and sarcasm.

appearance: A small, adorable myconid sprout standing just 2 feet tall. Stool resembles a walking mushroom with a broad, cap-shaped head in mottled shades of purple and gray. Two large, dark eye-spots on the cap give the impression of a curious, innocent face. Stubby arms and legs protrude from a pale, spongy stalk-body. When communicating, Stool releases clouds of faintly luminescent rapport spores that shimmer with soft blue-green light. Small patches of bioluminescent lichen grow on Stool's cap, providing a gentle glow.
backstory: Stool is a young myconid sprout who was separated from the sovereign circle in the fungal gardens of Neverlight Grove during a devastating drow slave raid. Too small and young to be of interest to the slavers, Stool hid among dead mushrooms until the raiders left, then wandered the tunnels alone, terrified and lost. The experience was Stool's first encounter with violence and cruelty, concepts completely alien to myconid culture. Myconids communicate entirely through rapport spores, sharing thoughts and emotions directly, and the idea that creatures could deliberately harm each other was incomprehensible. Despite the trauma, Stool's innate curiosity won out over fear, and the little sprout began to explore the wider Underdark with a determination surprising for such a small creature. Stool has become an invaluable guide, as myconids have an instinctive understanding of underground tunnel systems through the vast fungal networks that thread through the earth.

dmNotes.roleplaying: Play Stool as genuinely innocent and curious, not childish or stupid. Stool is a different kind of intelligence, one that understands ecosystems, fungal biology, and emotional resonance deeply, but is baffled by violence, deception, and individualism. Stool communicates through rapport spores, meaning that when Stool 'talks,' nearby creatures experience gentle telepathic impressions of images, emotions, and simple concepts rather than words. Narrate this as 'Stool releases a cloud of softly glowing spores, and you feel/see/sense...' Stool is a natural translator and peacemaker. When the party encounters other creatures, Stool often tries to establish rapport through spores before anyone reaches for a weapon. Stool finds violence deeply distressing and will visibly wilt or tremble when combat begins, though Stool will fight to protect friends. Stool's favorite thing is collecting colorful cave pebbles.
dmNotes.voice: Stool does not speak in words. Instead, narrate Stool's communication as spore-transmitted impressions. Example: 'Stool releases a puff of shimmering spores. Through them, you feel a warm sense of welcome, followed by a vivid image of a winding tunnel opening into a vast cavern filled with glowing mushrooms. There is a sense of home, tinged with sadness.' When expressing emotion, describe physical changes: happiness makes Stool's cap lighten and glow, fear makes it darken and shrink, curiosity makes the eye-spots widen and the cap tilt inquisitively.
dmNotes.motivations: Primary: Find a way back to Neverlight Grove and reunite with the sovereign circle. Secondary: Understand the bizarre, violent world of non-myconid creatures. Tertiary: Protect and nurture the party, whom Stool sees as a temporary circle. Stool is deeply invested in the group's emotional well-being and will try to resolve interpersonal conflicts through shared rapport-spore sessions.
dmNotes.secrets: Stool has begun to sense something deeply wrong in the direction of Neverlight Grove through the fungal network. The spore-signals from home have changed, becoming strange and discordant, hinting at a corruption spreading through the myconid sovereign. Stool has not shared this with the party because Stool cannot fully articulate what is wrong, only that home does not feel right anymore. This connects to Zuggtmoy's influence over the grove.
dmNotes.attitude: Unfailingly friendly, trusting, and eager to help. Stool bonds quickly and deeply with anyone who shows kindness. Stool is particularly drawn to characters who seem sad or lonely, and will offer rapport-spore sessions as comfort (essentially a fungal hug that shares warmth and belonging). Stool is wary of drow due to the slave raid trauma, and will shrink behind larger party members when drow are encountered.
